design.repair1_snapshot_guard: Observed node UUIDs must have both runtime entries in every fresh snapshot unless v2 removal proof already exists. Missing UUID raises TeardownObservationError and RECOVERED_NODE_MISSING_FROM_SNAPSHOT. The chosen disposition rejects; it never equates probe recovery with removal.
design.retry_rule: at each 0.5 s poll, after docker inspect proves the same identity, running, OOMKilled=false, RestartCount=0 and an unchanged container State.Pid, the same probe (same argv, timeout 10 s, check=False) is repeated once; accepted only if it returns 0 with ActiveState=active before the deadline since+30 s; an admitted node (ocor-bootstrap network attached) also needs NRestarts=0; then a fresh snapshot is taken under the same deadline and consumed by the unchanged check_kubernetes_runtimes
design.retry_scope: only the exact runtime probe [docker, exec, <64-hex owned node>, systemctl, show, containerd|kubelet, --property=ActiveState,MainPID,NRestarts]; any other exec or inspect keeps the unchanged v2 absence/destroy/remover path
design.stderr_capture: run_probe records exit code and stderr for every failed probe (non-zero result, CalledProcessError, TimeoutExpired); stderr is redacted with the bootstrap.env TOKEN/PASSWORD values, private-key blocks and NAME=value assignments for TOKEN/PASSWORD/SECRET names, then bounded to the last 500 characters
